title: 1901 Prairie Avenue — the Ream house built from its 1898 photograph
items: Norman B. Ream's house at 1901 Prairie, a generic draft block until now, stands as the light stone house of its 1898 photograph: two tall storeys over a raised basement under a slated mansard with dormers and an iron cresting.
Its stone porch on paired columns carries a balustraded balcony at the stoop's head, where the photographs put it, and the south flank's canted bay rises through both storeys.
